rules.statement: Don't report a changelog entry for naming a setting the way users write it in their configuration rather than the way an internal script or tool prints it; the changelog is written for users and should use the form they set.
rules.why: The changelog's readers set the option in its user-facing form. An internal output format that only tooling reads is not what they see, and other entries already name options in the user-facing form.
rules.check: Before reporting a mismatch between a changelog entry and how code or scripts spell a setting, check whether the entry uses the form from the user-facing configuration or docs, and whether other changelog entries name options the same way. If both are true, don't report it.
